segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports burning and irritation and advises against use for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age (50 years old, or simply 'getting older') report a firmer, plumper, more hydrated look.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers and those citing age report a plumping, firming effect and interest in collagen for skin that is 'getting older'; results are described as visible within weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report increased hydration and moisture, with one saying two pumps lasts all day and another noting products layered afterward work better.
concerns.redness: One reviewer describes burning and irritation on sensitive skin; no other reviewer reports redness.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the serum is 'not greasy' despite being hydrating; no other comments on oiliness are given.

extraits.titre: This is a steal for the results it delivers
extraits.texte: I've been using the VT Collagen Reedle Shot for only a few weeks, and I am genuinely impressed. At 50 years old, it's hard to find products that provide an immediate 'plump' effect, but this has definitely done it! My skin feels firmer and looks much more hydrated.

I tried the trial kit of the reedle shots Liked all of them. Purchased the full size collagen shot. I need more collagen as I'm getting older. Can't wait to see my face after 4 weeks of use. Any of the reedle shots are great. Pick one that your face needs you won't be disappointed.
I didnt know what to expect but i was surprised. Not greasy but super hydrating. Two pumps lasts all day!
I have noticed that my skin looks more smoother, less texture and smaller pores when I used the Reedle shot (2-3 times a week) consistently.

I have had this for almost a month and from the first time i used it, it gave immediate results. My skin feels so much moisturized ,thanks to the needles, my toners and moisturizer definitely make more of a difference now. And nothing beats the vitamin E, collagen and the other things it carrys. 10/10

I've used other VT Cosmetics products. I like their other Reedle shot options, but this definitely makes my skin plumper due to the collagen. I use it every morning and night before applying my other products. Definitely recommend for a fuller look!

reserve: With only 11 reviews and a single mention of sensitive skin and mature skin each, the segment-level conclusions are based on very limited evidence.
